description: This Java source file defines the EventConsumerImpl class, which implements a message consumer for receiving event messages from a Hono server using Vertx-Proton. It provides a factory method to create instances of the consumer configured for a specific tenant and handles connection setup and message consumption logic.

classes.name: EventConsumerImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for consuming event messages from a Hono server, extending AbstractConsumer and implementing MessageConsumer.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to asynchronously create an EventConsumerImpl instance for a specific tenant, setting up the receiver with appropriate QoS and event consumer handling.
